name: popup
description: Explain jargon in any project with hover/tap popups — one glossary JSON as the single source (meaning, plain-words comparison, examples, source code, related terms, learn-more links to your own pages), a drop-in popup.js/css with no build step, a checker, a doc audit that finds undefined jargon, and Markdown links with hover titles for READMEs. Builds on SONUB's own glossary in SONUB.
